reasons: Numeric warning signals (3 of 4 computable): most of the Beneish M, Dechow F, accruals and OCF/net-income signals fire, the strongest quantitative signs of possible earnings manipulation or aggressive accruals on this card.
Prior-period corrections and accounting changes (1 of 3): at least one restatement/revision, voluntary accounting change or segment change, which can point to past errors or earnings management.
Investigations and litigation (1 of 3): one of SEC inquiry, class action or other government action is present, adding external scrutiny risk.
Financial pressure (2 of 4): two pressure items (e.g. revenue/EPS-linked incentive pay, capital raise, covenant or going-concern issues) give motive to manage results.

Transaction complexity (3 of 8): several judgment-heavy areas (over-time revenue, contract assets, related parties, acquisitions, inventory write-downs or concentration) widen the room for estimation error or manipulation.

Mitigating: internal control and audit (0 of 4) shows no material weakness, adverse ICFR opinion, auditor change or disagreement, and management turnover (0 of 2) shows no CEO/CFO change, so the score stays moderate rather than high. The card gives only area counts, not specific F/R IDs, so the specific items cannot be checked.
